title: Baby Blue Punch
description: This beautiful baby blue shower punch recipe can be made with any flavor or color of unsweetened drink mix; top with scoops of floating ice cream.
ingredients: 1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
1 (64 fluid ounce) bottle white cranberry juice
1 (0.13 ounce) package blue, berry flavored unsweetened drink mix
1 cup white sugar, or to taste

steps.text: Combine lemon-lime soda, white cranberry juice, and drink mix in a large punch bowl until well mixed; stir in sugar until reaches desired sweetness.
Float ice cream on top. The ice cream will start to melt and look like frothy white clouds floating on top.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make a bright blue, refreshing punch. Any flavor of drink mix will work, but this recipe uses berry blue to make the punch a baby blue color. Lemon-lime soda, white cranberry juice and sugar are stirred in next. All that's left is a few scoops of vanilla ice cream to float on top. As the ice cream melts, it will create a frothy, cloud-like topping!
